package.name: fp3_apriltag_demo
package.description: Reads one AprilTag detection from /detections, estimates its 3D pose via solvePnP, transforms it into fp3_link0 via TF (handeye_tf_publisher's calibration), and moves fp3_hand_tcp directly to that pose -- gripper kept open, no grasp/lift. A real-hardware check that the eye-on-base calibration is accurate: compare fp3_hand_tcp against the tag's own live TF frame afterward (in RViz, or via tf2_echo) -- translation close to [0,0,0] once settled means the calibration checks out at that point.
